compute_box3d_overlap: compute the intersection volume and IoU of two sets of 3D boxes defined by 8 corners each
check_coplanar_box_faces: check that the vertices on each face of a 3D box are coplanar within a tolerance
check_nonzero_box_faces: check that all triangular faces of a 3D box have non-zero area
review_box3d_overlap_autograd: review the _box3d_overlap autograd Function wrapper that delegates to the C++ CUDA iou_box3d kernel
summarize_box3d_constants: summarize the _box_planes and _box_triangles constants that define quad and triangle face connectivity of 3D box corners
